mapper.select: SELECT name, created_at FROM tb_users WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT cp.id AS completion_id, c.id AS course_id, c.title, i.name AS institution_name, cp.completed_at, c.classification_code, (SELECT cr.id FROM tb_credential_groups g JOIN tb_credentials cr ON cr.credential_group_id = g.id WHERE g.completion_id = cp.id AND cr.status = 'ISSUED' ORDER BY cr.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS credential_id FROM tb_completions cp JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN tb_institutions i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY cp.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, cp.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends_at - s.starts_at)) / 60), 0)::bigint FROM tb_course_sessions s WHERE s.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND s.course_id IN ( SELECT e.course_id FROM tb_completions cp JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' )
mapper.sql: FROM tb_credentials cr JOIN tb_credential_groups g ON g.id = cr.credential_group_id JOIN tb_completions cp ON cp.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN tb_institutions i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.status = 'ISSUED'
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.id, cr.credential_no, c.title AS course_title, i.name AS institution_name, cp.completed_at, cr.issued_at, cr.status
ORDER BY cr.issued_at DESC NULLS LAST, cr.id

SELECT b.id, b.definition_id, d.code AS definition_code, COALESCE(d.name, b.badge_name) AS name, COALESCE(CAST(tier ->> 'imageFileId' AS uuid), d.image_file_id) AS image_file_id, b.issued_at, b.tier_level, tier ->> 'name' AS tier_name FROM tb_learning_badges b LEFT JOIN tb_badge_definitions d ON d.id = b.definition_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT level FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN d.rule_type = 'TIERED' THEN d.rule_params -> 'levels' END) level WHERE CAST(level ->> 'level' AS integer) = b.tier_level ) t(tier) ON TRUE WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'ISSUED' ORDER BY b.issued_at DESC NULLS LAST, b.id
